cohort: 53 women who underwent operative treatment for UTE at Helsinki University Hospital between 2004 and 2013
finding: The study found that the complication rate of UTE operations is acceptable, recurrences are rare, infertility is common, but a majority of those who wished for a child succeeded, and a majority of the deliveries involved unplanned and complicated cesarean section.
mod_finding: A majority of the women who delivered (75%) had a cesarean section, with intraoperative difficulties occurring in 83% of these cases.
